title: lefsim model
description: A lefsim model, version 2: a lattice with CTCFs, the LEFs on it, their rates and a spawn rule. Loading also runs the checks a schema can't express, such as CTCF sites and leg positions lying inside the lattice.

lefs.description: One entry per LEF; LEF i is entry i.

position.description: A site index, from 0 to n_sites - 1.

mobility.description: A leg's intrinsic mobility. Whether it's blocked is derived, not stored.

ctcfs.description: At most one CTCF per site. Defaults to none.

captures_from.description: The CTCF's capture side. Legs arriving from the other side may be evicted.

strength.description: The probability p of capture from the capture side, or eviction from the other side.

lef.description: left_pos <= right_pos. A LEF's two legs may share a site; two LEFs may not. A captured leg sits on a CTCF that captures from the side it arrived from: right for a left leg, left for a right leg.

rate.description: Events per unit time, positive and finite.

respawn_blocked.description: The unloading rate while either leg is blocked.

respawn_captured.description: The unloading rate while either leg is captured; it takes precedence over respawn_blocked.

spawn.description: Where an unloaded LEF binds again.

rule.description: uniform_non_ctcf: a uniformly random site that isn't a CTCF and isn't occupied, with both legs on it. It needs at least 2n - 1 non-CTCF sites for n LEFs.
